name: DashCore
description: A lightweight Android64 performance toolkit for Geometry Dash. DashCore profiles level updates and render traversal, validates a Bismuth-inspired GLES compute visibility mask, and keeps experimental object culling disabled by default while safety checks are developed.

experimental-render-culling.name: Experimental render culling
experimental-render-culling.description: Experimental CPU-side off-screen draw culling. Disabled by default. Effects and triggers are protected; grouped objects near the player are protected. The GPU visibility-mask test is diagnostic only and never changes game rendering.
